note: outside the 12 cells, round 3 (facade palette of the far-zone schools the 2024-05 Commons photos sample). The three grounds (条南中 x -1250..-1050 z 1660..1900, 鹿折中 x 1200..1340 z -1400..-1190, 鹿折小 x 530..700 z -1870..-1700) are drawn by the school landmark model (schools.js), whose per-ground palette lives in SCHOOL_INFO.<ground>.look (sites.js, [v6:schools-r3]); the wall values here keep the layout in step with it (test/v6-schools-r3.test.js). 気仙沼中, 気仙沼高, 九条小 and 東陵高 are not sampled by any recent photo and keep the default grey-white palette; 気仙沼小 keeps its concrete variant. 鹿折中's lot /196 is the 3-storey classroom block (GSI hull of the block, its wings and the courtyard): the area rule had it a 14.1 m barrel-roofed gym. The roof colour of 鹿折小 (#4a4d55) is SCHOOL_INFO.schShishioriE.look.roof: 'outside cells (鹿折小, far zone).json' applies after this file (file-name order) and sets #5c6371 on the same lots, so a roof colour written here would lose.
